qualifier: ERK5, p38 and atypical MAPK branches
name: TRKA-driven MAPK signalling including ERK5, p38 and atypical MAPKs
rationale: Members are MAPK cascades (ERK5, p38, MAPK6/4, RAS-MAPK) and their CREB/transcriptional outputs downstream of NGF/TRKA adaptors (FRS2, ARMS); unlike the confusables they carry the ERK5, p38 and atypical MAPK arms rather than NTRK3, PI3K, PLCG1 or STAT3 branches.

name: BMP/TGF-beta-SMAD signalling regulation, including extracellular ligand sequestration
rationale: All members concern positive or negative control of BMP, TGF-beta, NODAL and SMAD signalling, and unlike the confusables (SMAD transcription/miRNA, somitogenesis, left-right, endothelial fate) the theme includes extracellular sequestration of ligands from receptors.

name: Cardiac conduction system development and action-potential depolarization
rationale: Members cover SA/AV node and His-Purkinje development, pacemaker (HCN) and phase 0 depolarization and electrical coupling, whereas the confusables centre on repolarization, potassium channels and contraction control.

core: Vascular wall smooth muscle and endothelial programmes
name: Vascular smooth muscle differentiation and SRF contractile gene programme
rationale: Members are vascular smooth muscle development, differentiation and matrix adhesion, SRF-target cytoskeletal/contractile modules and perivascular/endothelial identity modules, whereas confusables emphasize smooth muscle phenotypic switching, proliferation/migration or endothelial shear-stress responses.

name: Iron homeostasis with plasma heme scavenging and uptake
rationale: Members concern iron import, iron response and organismal iron balance together with heme scavenging, transport and assimilation, which the confusables (transferrin cycle, oxygen sensing, cadmium) lack.

core: Steroid and thyroid hormone production and response
name: Adrenal and gonadal steroidogenesis and thyroid hormone signalling
rationale: Members span corticosteroid, sex steroid and pregnenolone biosynthesis (with steroidogenic CYP defects), glucocorticoid secretion/response and thyroid hormone generation, transport and signalling, distinct from vitamin D/retinoid CYP metabolism and GH/prolactin/leptin signalling in the confusables.

name: IL-12 family and IL-10 cytokine signalling
rationale: Members are signalling by IL-12, IL-23, IL-27 and IL-35 (the IL-12 family) plus IL-10, separating the theme from IL-20/type III interferon, IL-15/IL-21 and IL-37 confusables.

name: Lipid droplet formation and phospholipid synthesis regulation
rationale: Members cover lipid droplet formation, fusion and organization, regulation of phosphatidylcholine/phospholipid and triglyceride synthesis and an adipocyte lipid-storage module, whereas confusables focus on lipophagy, droplet disassembly and triglyceride homeostasis.

name: Craniofacial, pharyngeal gland and limb embryonic morphogenesis
rationale: Members are morphogenesis of face, palate, ear, nose and skull, pharyngeal-derived glands (thymus, parathyroid, thyroid, pituitary) and limbs/digits, distinct from neural plate patterning, cochlear, outflow-tract and exocrine-gland confusables.

name: AKT-FOXO, p53 and mTORC1 control of glucose metabolism
rationale: Members combine AKT regulation of FOXO localization and activity, p53 metabolic targets and mTORC1 with regulation of glycolysis and the pentose phosphate shunt, whereas confusables centre on NRF2 targets or fructose bisphosphate/fermentation.

name: tRNA, rRNA and mRNA methylation and pseudouridylation
rationale: Members are base and 2'-O methylation and pseudouridine synthesis on tRNA, rRNA and mRNA, distinct from snoRNP assembly, mitochondrial RNA modification and tRNA processing/aminoacylation confusables.

core: Regulation of insulin sensitivity and glucose uptake
name: Insulin sensitivity, glucose uptake regulation and adiponectin signalling
rationale: Members regulate insulin receptor signalling and cellular insulin response, glucose import and glycogen synthesis, plus adiponectin secretion and signalling, which distinguishes the theme from glucagon, GLUT4 translocation and IRS/AKT2 confusables.

core: SUMOylation and mitotic nuclear envelope dynamics
name: SUMOylation and mitotic nuclear envelope disassembly and resealing
rationale: Members are the SUMO conjugation cascade and SUMOylation of nuclear targets together with mitotic nuclear envelope breakdown, reassembly, ESCRT-III sealing and abscission, unlike nuclear pore transport and chromosome condensation confusables.

qualifier: feeding, stress, sleep and social behaviour
name: Neuropeptide control of feeding, stress, sleep and social behaviour
rationale: Members are neuropeptide/GPCR signalling and HPA-axis hormone responses governing appetite, stress, sleep-wake, mating, parental and aggressive behaviour, distinct from GH/prolactin growth signalling and dopaminergic drug-response confusables.

core: Mitochondrial respiration and oxidative cell death
name: Mitochondrial respiration regulation and peroxide-induced apoptosis and ferroptosis
rationale: Members regulate oxidative phosphorylation, electron transport and ATP synthesis together with hydrogen peroxide-induced intrinsic apoptosis and ferroptosis, which confusables (ischaemia, nitrosative stress, hypoxia) lack.

name: Immature myeloid progenitor expansion and restrained myeloid differentiation
rationale: Members are common myeloid progenitor proliferation, a promyelocyte granule-protein module and negative regulation of granulocyte, monocyte and macrophage differentiation, contrasting with confusables that promote monocyte/macrophage, megakaryocyte or stem-cell programmes.

name: MITF-M-driven melanocyte programme and melanin pigmentation
rationale: Members are MITF-M regulation and its target gene sets plus melanin synthesis, melanocyte proliferation/differentiation and light responses, separating the theme from melanosome assembly and keratinocyte confusables.

qualifier: omega-3 pro-resolving mediators and eicosanoid inactivation
name: Omega-3 pro-resolving mediator synthesis and eicosanoid inactivation
rationale: Members are biosynthesis of resolvins, protectins, maresins and lipoxins with HETE production and leukotriene/eicosanoid catabolism, whereas confusables cover leukotriene synthesis and receptors, hepoxilins or PAF metabolism.

core: Amino acid and organic acid metabolism
name: General amino acid and organic acid metabolism
rationale: All members are broad (obsolete) parent terms for amino acid and organic acid metabolism, biosynthesis and catabolism, unlike confusables tied to specific amino acids such as threonine, tyrosine or proline.

name: Pathogenic MECP2 loss of methyl-DNA binding and phosphorylation
rationale: All three members describe loss of MECP2 binding to 5mC/5hmC DNA or of its T308 phosphorylation, distinct from DNA methylation machinery, CaMK-CREB and MECP2 target-gene confusables.

qualifier: arterial and coronary, endothelial differentiation control
name: Arterial and coronary vascular development and endothelial differentiation
rationale: Members cover arterial endothelial and dorsal aorta formation, coronary vasculogenesis, cardiac vascular smooth muscle differentiation and regulation of endothelial differentiation with BMP inhibition, unlike venous, CNS and lymphatic confusables.

core: Regulation of intracellular store calcium release
name: Ryanodine receptor control of sarco/endoplasmic reticulum calcium release
rationale: Members regulate release of sequestered calcium from ER/SR via ryanodine-sensitive channels including in skeletal muscle contraction, whereas confusables concern cardiac calcium handling or store-operated calcium entry.

name: Urea cycle and arginine, citrulline and ornithine synthesis
rationale: Members are the urea cycle, its transcriptional repression and synthesis/metabolism of arginine, citrulline and ornithine, distinct from urea-cycle disease variants and arginine catabolism/transport confusables.

qualifier: Hedgehog autoprocessing and RAS C-terminal processing
name: Hedgehog autoprocessing, lipidation and RAS C-terminal processing
rationale: Members are Hedgehog self-cleavage, palmitoylation and release, N-terminal lipidation and RAS C-terminal processing, separating the theme from WNT/PORCN palmitoylation and depalmitoylation confusables.

name: Adrenergic Gi/z-inhibited cAMP synthesis, degradation and PKA activation
rationale: Members cover cAMP synthesis, PDE degradation and PKA activation together with alpha-2 adrenergic and G alpha z inhibition of adenylate cyclase and catecholamine secretion, unlike confusables centred on Gq calcium, dopamine/CREB or adenosine signalling.
